predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Kashima vs Fagiano Okayama: Expected Goals (xG), Defensive Gaps & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Kashima hold the attacking and home-pitch edge, yet Fagiano Okayama's unbroken away scoring streak makes a narrow home win or 1:1 draw the balanced full-time projection.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw anchored by Kashima's 1.66 lambda and 62.5% home win rate against Okayama's one-goal road resilience (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 goals and Both Teams To Score supported by 2.70 combined lambda and Okayama's 87.5% away BTTS frequency (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
1:1 draw contingency if Okayama's 3-4-2-1 pressing block disrupts Kashima's build-up and exploits a set-piece chance (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Kashima home firepower tests Okayama's 100% away scoring streak.

spf.comment: Kashima's 1.61 xG per game and 62.5% home win rate favor a 2:1 win, while Okayama's 8-for-8 away scoring record and 12.2% 1:1 baseline prevent relying on a single home win.

over_under.comment: Combined 2.70 lambda, Kashima's 60.0% season Over 2.5 rate, and Okayama's 75.0% away Over 2.5 rate support three or more goals.

btts.comment: Kashima's 20.0% overall clean-sheet rate and Okayama's 12.5% away clean-sheet rate align with Okayama scoring in all eight away league matches.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Kashima's home attacking edge alongside Okayama's unbroken road scoring and four single-goal away losses, with 1:1 covering the tightest draw branch.

goals.comment: Three goals align with the 2:1 primary script and Kashima's 3.67 actual goals per match, while two goals match the 25.1% modal Poisson bin and 1:1 alternative.

bqc.comment: Kashima lead at half-time in 50.0% of home league matches and have won all five HT leads this season, while Okayama's 62.5% away HT draw rate sustains the Draw-Draw fork.
